# slotplan

slotplan is the small scheduling library behind the office room-booking bot and the support-desk rota sheet. Times are plain integers counted in minutes since midnight and weekdays are indices 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday), so there is no dependency on datetime or a time-zone database. It covers parsing and formatting clock times, interval arithmetic on busy/free calendars, room assignment and recurring meetings, and checks on weekly shift rotas.

## Layout
- `src/slotplan/` - one module per function; each module is owned by one engineer (see CODEOWNERS)
- `tests/` - unit tests, maintained by the module owner
- `acceptance/` - acceptance checks maintained by QA; CI gates every ticket on them
- `docs/` - CI, release and contribution notes

## Sprint
This sprint finishes the open modules listed in the ticket board. Release cut: end of cycle 18.
